# Cncf K6 Reviewer

Review k6 using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Continuous Integration &amp; Delivery category. k6 is a developer-centric, free and open-source load testing tool built for making performance testing a productive and enjoyable experience. Using k6, you&#39;ll be able to catch performance regression and problems earlier, allowing you to build resilient systems and robust applications.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
